important_rules_for_next_agent: Continue working directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule.
Do not perform broad UserApp refactors.
Do not combine UI redesign with modularization.
Do not change backend behavior under Phase 6 unless explicitly requested.
Do not change Wiki content-control behavior under Phase 6.
After each small frontend extraction, run npm run typecheck and npm run build from apps/everything-ai-ui.
Only run backend npm test if backend files or backend-facing API shapes are touched.
Do not let AI summaries populate source-backed document body content.
Do not add destructive file actions. Delete and permanent purge must remain blocked in the local MVP.

recommended_next_action.pm_recommendation: Stop and reassess before more extractions. UserApp is now much more modular. The next safe step is either to record a final Phase 6 validation doc or inspect UserApp.tsx for one remaining obvious low-risk extraction.

suggested_next_small_extractions_if_cont.reason: This is larger than the previous helpers because it coordinates index, extract, insights, Wiki loading, file loading, and setup progress. Do not extract unless prepared to validate carefully.
This coordinates chat state, ask view switching, chat API call, assistant response, and focus behavior. Extract only if done as a dedicated small hook with immediate validation.
Could become a UserMainViews component, but be careful not to hide too many props or make debugging harder.

do_not_do_next: Do not start AI Organization Workspace implementation as part of Phase 6.
Do not start enterprise governance tickets as local MVP work.
Do not change APIs or DB schemas during frontend modularization.
Do not skip frontend typecheck after another extraction.
